def compress(grid):
    """The grid without its frontiers: every row and every column that is one color throughout."""
    rows = {i for i, row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row)) == 1}
    cols = {j for j in range(len(grid[0])) if len({row[j] for row in grid}) == 1}
    return [[v for j, v in enumerate(row) if j not in cols] for i, row in enumerate(grid) if i not in rows]

def upscale(grid, factor):
    """Each cell as a factor x factor block of its color."""
    return [[v for v in row for _ in range(factor)] for row in grid for _ in range(factor)]

def crop(grid, top, left, height, width):
    """The height x width subgrid whose top-left cell is (top, left)."""
    return [row[left:left + width] for row in grid[top:top + height]]

def trim(grid):
    """The grid without its outermost rows and columns."""
    return [row[1:-1] for row in grid[1:-1]]

def replace(grid, old, new):
    """The grid with every cell of color old recolored new."""
    return [[new if v == old else v for v in row] for row in grid]

def hperiod(grid):
    """The smallest p such that every row repeats itself every p cells: the grid's width if none is smaller."""
    w = len(grid[0])
    return next(p for p in range(1, w + 1) if all(row[j] == row[j - p] for row in grid for j in range(p, w)))

from lib import upscale
def transform(grid):

def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):

            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:

                    if (y,x) in seen or not(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W) or g[y][x]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); cells.add((y,x))
                    st+= [(y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)]
                ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                out.append({'col':col,'cells':cells,'top':min(ys),'bot':max(ys),'l':min(xs),'r':max(xs)})
    return out

    h=sh['bot']-sh['top']+1; w=sh['r']-sh['l']+1
    return len(sh['cells'])==2*h+2*w-4  # full outline

def solve(g):

    shapes=comps(g)
    rings=[s for s in shapes if is_ring(s)]
    plus=[s for s in shapes if not is_ring(s)]
    rings.sort(key=lambda s:s['top'])
    plus.sort(key=lambda s:-s['bot'])
    placed=[]
    def put(s,r0,order_check):
        h=s['bot']-s['top']+1; w=s['r']-s['l']+1
        pat=[[1 if (s['top']+i,s['l']+j) in s['cells'] else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        r=r0
        while True:
            cellsr={(r+i,s['l']+j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if pat[i][j]}
            if not any(c in p for p in placed for c in cellsr):
                break
            r+= order_check  # 1 for downward group, -1 handled by caller
        for (y,x) in cellsr: out[y][x]=s['col']
        placed.append(cellsr)
        return r
    for s in rings:
        h=s['bot']-s['top']+1; w=s['r']-s['l']+1
        pat=[[1 if (s['top']+i,s['l']+j) in s['cells'] else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        r=0
        while any((r+i,s['l']+j) in p for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if pat[i][j] for p in placed):
            r+=1
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if pat[i][j]: out[r+i][s['l']+j]=s['col']
        placed.append({(r+i,s['l']+j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if pat[i][j]})
    placed=[]
    for s in plus:
        h=s['bot']-s['top']+1; w=s['r']-s['l']+1
        pat=[[1 if (s['top']+i,s['l']+j) in s['cells'] else 0 for j in range(w)] for i in range(h)]
        r=H-h
        while any((r+i,s['l']+j) in p for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if pat[i][j] for p in placed):
            r-=1
        for i in range(h):
            for j in range(w):
                if pat[i][j]: out[r+i][s['l']+j]=s['col']
        placed.append({(r+i,s['l']+j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w) if pat[i][j]})
    return out

def is_ring(sh):
    h=sh['bot']-sh['top']+1; w=sh['r']-sh['l']+1

def comps(g):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); seen=set(); out=[]
    for i in range(H):
        for j in range(W):
            if g[i][j] and (i,j) not in seen:
                col=g[i][j]; st=[(i,j)]; cells=set()
                while st:
                    y,x=st.pop()
                    if (y,x) in seen or not(0<=y<H and 0<=x<W) or g[y][x]!=col: continue
                    seen.add((y,x)); cells.add((y,x))
                    st+= [(y+1,x),(y-1,x),(y,x+1),(y,x-1)]
                ys=[c[0] for c in cells]; xs=[c[1] for c in cells]
                out.append({'col':col,'cells':cells,'top':min(ys),'bot':max(ys),'l':min(xs),'r':max(xs)})
    return out

def apply_rule2(g, ring_key, plus_key, ring_rev, plus_rev, bbox):
    H,W=len(g),len(g[0]); out=[[0]*W for _ in range(H)]
    placed=set()
    sh=comps(g)
    rings=sorted([s for s in sh if is_ring(s)], key=ring_key, reverse=ring_rev)
    plus=sorted([s for s in sh if not is_ring(s)], key=plus_key, reverse=plus_rev)
    def place2(s, up):
        h=s['bot']-s['top']+1; w=s['r']-s['l']+1
        rel=sorted((y-s['top'],x-s['l']) for (y,x) in s['cells'])
        r = 0 if up else H-h
        step = 1 if up else -1
        while True:
            occ={(r+dy, s['l']+dx) for (dy,dx) in rel}
            bb={(r+i,s['l']+j) for i in range(h) for j in range(w)} if bbox else occ
            if not (bb & placed): break
            r+=step
            if r<0 or r>H-h: return None
        placed.update(occ)
        for (y,x) in occ: out[y][x]=s['col']
        return True
    for s in rings:
        if place2(s,True) is None: return None
    for s in plus:
        if place2(s,False) is None: return None
